To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• Measurement is an important part of service management but not the only part.
• The art and science of service delivery are equally important.
• Service leaders need to develop their own service leadership model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between the art and the science of management, and the extent to which each can be used to improve the quality of services.
how to measure the performance of service delivery, how to manage service performance, and how to develop the art and science of service management.
how to develop and use measurement systems in a way that supports service leaders to improve their services.

measurement should be used as a means to an end, not as an end itself.
the art of service is the most important aspect of service management, and that the science of service management is the most important tool in service delivery.
the science of service measurement is not a substitute for the art of service leadership and the two are not mutually exclusive.

the art of service is the art of leadership and the science of service is the science of measurement.
